title: Contract list load swallows errors with .catch(() => setLoading(false))
detail: Line 30: `.catch(() => setLoading(false))` â€” on load failure the loading spinner disappears and the table shows 'No contracts found.' which is indistinguishable from an empty state. Users cannot distinguish 'you have no contracts' from 'the load failed'. Affects external user testing because tester will report 'missing data' that's actually a 401/403/500.
recommendedFix:
Capture the error in state and render a distinct banner when present: add `const [error, setError] = useState(null);`, change .catch to `.catch(e => { setError(e.message); setLoading(false); })`, and render `{error &&
Unable to load contracts: {error}
}` before the table.

title: Inline searchFields array literal passed to useTableControls â€” defeats useMemo cache
detail: Line 21-25: `useTableControls(contracts, { ... searchFields: ['dcfg_contract_number', ...] })` â€” the searchFields array is allocated fresh on every render. useTableControls uses this in a useMemo dependency; a new array reference each render invalidates the memo, forcing re-filter on every keystroke/state change. Pattern is called out in Phase 1 shared-module findings as the canonical perf bug. Same issue exists in MsaList.jsx:66 and Onboarding.jsx uses a module-level constant correctly (ONBOARDING_SEARCH_FIELDS:31).
evidence: ContractList.jsx:24 â€” searchFields is an inline array literal.
recommendedFix: Hoist the array to a module-level constant: `const CONTRACT_SEARCH_FIELDS = ['dcfg_contract_number', 'dcfg_client_name', 'dcfg_contractor_legal_name', 'dcfg_msa_id.dcfg_customer_id.dcfg_name'];` at the top of the file, then pass `searchFields: CONTRACT_SEARCH_FIELDS` in the options object.

title: ContractList imports `isManager` from usePortalUser but never uses it
detail: Line 17: `const { isManager } = usePortalUser();` â€” the destructured value is never referenced in the component body. Dead import â€” clean up during Phase 2b console/import pass or as part of the batch fix for CR-0252.
evidence: ContractList.jsx:17. grep for isManager in this file returns only the destructure.
recommendedFix: Remove the isManager destructure â€” or if an admin-only action is supposed to be here, add it. Cross-check with CR-2026-04-09-0248 pattern for ContractDetail.
